articles.title: Pokémon Pokopia's New Underwater World: Will It Be Awesome or Awful?
articles.summary: Pokémon Pokopia is getting a watery new area called Bubbly Basin. You'll be able to dive underwater with your Pokémon! But underwater levels in games are often tricky. Will this one be fun?

articles.title: This Keyboard Is So Smart, It Can Tell How Hard You're Pressing!
articles.summary: The Wooting 60HE v2 is a keyboard that uses magnets instead of regular switches. It can sense how far down you press a key, letting you walk or sprint in games with just one button! It's super fast and customizable.

articles.title: Olympic Swimmer Ryan Lochte Is Engaged! Here's the Sweet Story
articles.summary: Ryan Lochte, a famous swimmer who won 12 Olympic medals, just got engaged to his girlfriend Molly Gillihan. He proposed at a restaurant in Gainesville, Florida—the same place they had their first date!
